ManageUsers.title: User Management
ManageUsers.description: Manage all users in the system, search for specific accounts, and filter by role or status.

empty.title: No users found
empty.description: Try adjusting your search or filters to find what you're looking for.

actions.suspendConfirmDescription: Are you sure you want to suspend this user? This will log them out and prevent them from accessing most system features.
actions.banConfirmDescription: Are you sure you want to PERMANENTLY ban this user? Their properties will move to draft, listings and appointments will be cancelled, and agent assignments will be detached.
actions.banWarning: This action blocks the account and refreshes affected properties, listings, appointments, subscriptions, and agent assignments.
actions.confirmBanInstruction: Please type "{email}" to confirm this action.
actions.deleteConfirmDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this account? The account will be marked deleted while owned properties move to draft and active business records are cancelled.
actions.deleteWarning: This action disables the account and refreshes affected properties, listings, appointments, subscriptions, and agent assignments.
actions.confirmDeleteInstruction: Please type "{email}" to confirm this action.
